name: article-meter
description: A pane with your Markdown draft's words per numbered part, one part's share and the placeholders left, kept current as Claude edits it

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: The draft's path, relative to the project. A * in the file name picks the newest match.

markers.title: Work-left markers
markers.description: Comma-separated texts counted as work left (outside HTML comments).

focusPart.title: Focus part
focusPart.description: The numbered part (## N.) whose share of the words is drawn as a bar. 0 hides it.

focusShare.title: Focus share (%)
focusShare.description: The share the focus part should reach; the bar's line.
